basic_info.description: Not Just A Home A Lifestyle Statement. Step into soaring ceilings, walls of glass, and a stage set for San Francisco living at its most iconic. This rare two-level loft is a showpiece where floor-to-ceiling windows erase the boundaries between your space and the city skyline. Culinary Excellence Quartz countertops, a Viking gas range, sleek under-cabinet lighting, and a statement island designed for both function and flair. Inspired Living Spaces Open, airy, and endlessly adaptable with the city as your ever-changing backdrop. Private Retreats Two sun-drenched bedrooms with oversized windows and sky-high ceilings, plus a versatile loft space perfect for a home office, creative studio, or quiet escape Custom closet organizers, polished hardwood floors, and secure garage parking that make life effortless. And beyond your front door? Oracle Park across the street. Chase Center minutes away. World class dining, arts, culture, and nightlife at your fingertips.This isnt just a condo.This is your front row ticket to the best of San Francisco.
